name: testimonial
title: Testimonial
description: The testimonial ad: a 4/5 headshot in the brand corner, the quote in Funnel Display in curly quotes, the name in DM Sans and the role and company in capitals.
use_for: One customer's words on a page or in an ad, with their real name, role and photo. Stacked as the ad sets it, or side by side on a wide page.
never: A made-up quote presented as a real customer's
Stars, logos or a card around it
More than one testimonial in view at once
source: Figma page 8: Ad, Testimonial (Headshot 464x580 at 64,160; the quote 920 wide at 812; the name at 1010; the role in capitals at 1050)
body:
The examples are Acme placeholders: put a real customer's quote, name, `position` and headshot (`image`) in their place.
`image={false}` (React) or `image="false"` leaves the headshot out.

examples.name: Stacked
examples.label: Stacked

examples.name: Side
examples.label: Side by side

props.name: position
props.description: Role and company, shown in capitals.

props.name: image
props.description: The headshot (src), the placeholder (undefined) or none (false).

examples.name: Stacked

attributes.description: Role and company, shown in capitals.

properties.name: position
properties.description: Role and company, shown in capitals.

examples.name: Stacked
examples.label: Stacked
examples.content:
<!-- As the ad sets it: the headshot above the quote. -->
<spyglass-testimonial class="w-160 max-w-full" quote="We see every launch in our category the day it goes live." name="Alex Rivera" position="Head of growth, Acme"></spyglass-testimonial>

examples.name: Side
examples.label: Side by side
examples.content:
<!-- On a wide page: the headshot beside the words. -->
<spyglass-testimonial layout="side" quote="Our Monday brief takes ten minutes now. It used to take a morning." name="Sam Okafor" position="Creative director, Acme Studio"></spyglass-testimonial>
